Oh, it’s the landlord.
Hmm maybe I could ask him about how to approach that cashier girl…
I know that he should be the last person to ask for advice, but he lived for quite some time, probably like 100 years at least, so I’m sure he knows his stuff.
Of course I have no intentions of revealing that she’s a bot. I will use some metaphor or some shit.
